business_rules.rule: Cancelled orders are excluded from the revenue report (only orders with status not equal to cancelled count)
Dollar totals stored as double are converted to cents by multiplying by 100 and rounding to 0 decimals
Revenue report returns the 5 largest orders by total_cents
Customer timeline maintains a 90-day rolling spend total per customer ordered by placed_at
A SKU is low-stock when on_hand is less than the given threshold and low-stock SKUs are counted per category
A cart's lifetime is 24 hours after its last touch/update.
Touching a cart marks it active and resets its expiry to 24 hours from now.
Only the customer's cart with status active counts as the current active cart.
A cart can only be discarded while it is still active; converted carts are not deleted by discard.
Converting a cart marks it converted and records the order_id that fulfilled it.
Storefront search returns at most 20 products by default
Autocomplete returns at most 8 name suggestions by default
Browsing products in a category returns at most 40 products by default
Storefront name/description/tags text matching tolerates at most 1 edit (fuzzy maxEdits 1)
Order items are assigned sequential line_id values starting at 1 (index + 1).
Each new order line starts with refunded amount 0.
Every new order starts with refund_total of 0.
Checkout fails with OutOfStock unless exactly 1 inventory document is updated per order line, meaning on_hand must cover the ordered qty.
New customers start with 0 loyalty points
Only 2 operation types — update and replace — on inventory create inventory_events entries; inserts and deletes are ignored.
referral chain lookup follows referred_by links up to 3 levels deep by default
An order can move to paid only from 1 prior status: placed
An order can move to shipped only from 1 prior status: paid
An order can move to delivered only from 1 prior status: shipped
An order can be cancelled only from 2 prior statuses: placed or paid, never after shipped
When an order is marked delivered, delivered_at must be set to the same transition time as updated_at
Every status change must append 1 history entry with the new status and timestamp while updating status
Customer order history returns at most 20 orders, newest placed_at first with _id tie-breaker
Search for orders containing a SKU returns at most 100 orders placed since the given date, newest first
Listing open orders by a status returns at most 50 orders, newest placed_at first
Tier discount is bronze 0%, silver 5%, gold 10%, legacy_vip 15% off subtotal
Coupon code WELCOME10 is worth 1000 off merchandise
legacy_vip tier cannot use coupons - any coupon is ignored for legacy_vip
Total discount (tier + coupon) is capped at subtotal so merchandise never goes negative
Discounted merchandise of 7500 or more gets free shipping, otherwise shipping is 795 flat
Tax is 8.5% (850 bps) applied to discounted merchandise excluding shipping
Orders in the legacy_vip tier may be refunded up to 90 days after delivered_at
Orders in all other tiers may be refunded up to 30 days after delivered_at
Items in the clearance category are final sale and are never eligible for refund
Only orders whose status is delivered or partially_refunded can be refunded
Only line items whose refund_status is none can be refunded; already refunded lines are excluded
After a refund the order status becomes partially_refunded if refundable lines remain, otherwise it becomes refunded
An order must include all 5 fields: customer_id, status, items, total and placed_at
Each order must contain at least 1 item
Order total must be 0 or greater
Order status must be one of 7 values: placed, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, partially_refunded, refunded
A customer can use the same coupon_code only once; orders without a coupon_code are exempt
Customer email addresses must be unique ignoring case (English collation strength 2)
Only carts with status active automatically expire at expires_at (expireAfterSeconds 0)
Product text search ranks name with weight 10, tags with weight 5 and description with weight 1
